CustomField.description: Non Production Calculated Overage Rate to allow for multiple services
CustomField.formula:
IF( ISPICKVAL(TSGCFG__Consolidation_Method__c, 'Average') && TSGCFG__TotalCPCLineItems__c > 0 , TSGCFG__SumofCPCOverageBW__c/ TSGCFG__TotalCPCLineItems__c, IF(TSGCFG__TotalBWVolume__c<> 0, TSGCFG__TotalBWOveragePrice__c / TSGCFG__TotalBWVolume__c, If(TSGCFG__TotalCPCLineItems__c > 0, TSGCFG__SumofCPCOverageBW__c/ TSGCFG__TotalCPCLineItems__c, 0)))
/* Below code is old and not in use */ /* IF( ISPICKVAL(TSGCFG__Consolidation_Method__c, 'Average') && TSGCFG__TotalCPCLineItems__c > 0 , TSGCFG__SumofCPCOverageBW__c/ TSGCFG__TotalCPCLineItems__c, IF(TSGCFG__TotalBWVolume__c<> 0, (TSGCFG__TotalBWOveragePrice__c+TSGCFG__TotalBWOveragePriceVolumeIncludes__c) / TSGCFG__TotalBWVolume__c, If(TSGCFG__TotalCPCLineItems__c > 0, TSGCFG__SumofCPCOverageBW__c/ TSGCFG__TotalCPCLineItems__c, 0)))*/
CustomField.label: B&W Overage Rate
